acceptanceCriteria: Recorded runs at load <= cores show heartbeat median <= 50 ms and heartbeat/renew p99 <= 250 ms at 40k receipts/15 writers, or a retained miss with cause.
body: PR #1415 (JSG lane, seal 2bd689f67) delivered V1-0887/V1-1512 partially; measured only under host load 20-35 (12 cores), so shape only. No measurement ran at load <= core count, so the 50 ms median and 250 ms p99 targets are unqualified.
title: Qualify V1-0887 and V1-1512 Tasks latency targets on a quiet host
